metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-167. - Appeal.
content.summary:
Any person may appeal any final written decision of the traffic engineer to the technical
               code advisory board. Any appeal to said board shall be processed and determined pursuant
               to this Code.
(Code 1981, § 30-152; Ord. No. 1544, § 9, 3-19-1979)
